intro.text: A Smoker in a crew Kelsier once led, able to hide others' Allomancy within his coppercloud.

items.text: Redd went with Kelsier's team into Kredik Shaw, using his coppercloud to conceal Mare's burning of tin. When they reached the inner chambers of the palace, Steel Inquisitors were already waiting for them, and Redd was killed on the spot.

Kelsier did not believe Redd could have sold them out, since he had only been told of the plan at the last minute, and he blamed Mare instead. Vin suggested that someone might have seen through Redd's coppercloud, then proved it could be done, so perhaps no one in the crew had betrayed them at all.
